strategicAuthority.title: Strategic Authority
strategicAuthority.description: Authority to set strategic direction and priorities
strategicAuthority.limitations: Must consult with Parliamentarian on procedural matters

coordinationAuthority.title: Coordination Authority
coordinationAuthority.description: Authority to coordinate and facilitate holon agent interactions
coordinationAuthority.scope: All holon agent coordination and communication
coordinationAuthority.limitations: Must respect holon agent autonomy and interests

decisionAuthority.title: Decision Authority
decisionAuthority.description: Authority to make executive decisions when consensus cannot be reached
decisionAuthority.limitations: Must report to Council and seek ratification

improvementAuthority.title: Improvement Authority
improvementAuthority.description: Authority to implement continuous improvement initiatives
improvementAuthority.limitations: Must consult with Parliamentarian on procedural changes
